account.description: The Beancount custody account the chain assertion is about.

commodity.description: The commodity/symbol the balance is denominated in.

postedBalance.description: The ledger's booked cumulative balance as an exact decimal or reduced fraction string, optionally unit-suffixed; null when never posted (treated as 0).

assertedBalance.description: The chain-witnessed balance as an exact decimal or reduced fraction string, optionally unit-suffixed.

assertionDate.description: The balance directive's own date (one day after its cutoff).

sourceId.description: The chain source id witnessing this assertion, carried onto the candidate transaction as source_id metadata.

openAccounts.description: Every account already opened in the ledger; a counter account absent from this list is opened by the derivation.
